title: Warming Crispy Russian Mussels Pilaf
description: A crispy, flavorful Russian-inspired dish featuring mussels, kimchi, and a hint of smokiness, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a mini cocotte over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mussels, kimchi, and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Add the buckwheat groats and stir to combine.
Cover the cocotte and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the mussels are opened and the buckwheat is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
